label: karindate30
title_zh: 错误的地点，错误的时间

lines.en: label karindate30:
I tap on Karin’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点了点 Karin 的名字，等着她接电话。

lines.en: If she’s putting together another care package for someone this time though, I’ll probably just sit things out.
lines.zh: 不过要是她这次又在给什么人准备慰问包裹，我大概就直接不掺和了。

lines.en: if makotolust30 == True:
As much as I liked being able to help Makoto in a way that wasn’t being borderline raped by her, I really {i}do{/i} want to spend more time with Karin alone.
lines.zh: 虽说我也很乐意用不被她半推半就地强上的方式帮到 Makoto，但我{i}真的{/i}很想多和 Karin 单独待一会儿。

lines.en: else:

As much as I liked being able to help Makoto in a way that was actually conducive to caring rather than showing up and destroying a picture of her father, I really {i}do{/i} want to spend more time with Karin alone.
lines.zh: 虽说我也很乐意用真正有助于关怀她的方式帮到 Makoto，而不是上门去砸烂她父亲的照片，但我{i}真的{/i}很想多和 Karin 单独待一会儿。

lines.en: Also, I want to see if I can make her hang up the phone even faster this time.
lines.zh: 另外，我还想看看这次能不能让她挂电话挂得更快一点。

lines.en: : Hello?
: Let’s go on a date.
lines.zh: : 我们去约会吧。

lines.en: : Wow. You’re still on the line. Good job, Karin.
lines.zh: : 哇。你居然还没挂。干得漂亮，Karin。

lines.en: : W-W-W-W-W-What did you just say?!
lines.zh: : 你、你、你、你、你刚才说什么？！

lines.en: : Let’s go on a date.
lines.zh: : 我们去约会吧。

lines.en: : Together?!
lines.zh: : 两个人一起？！

lines.en: : No. Let’s go on two separate dates in different locations and then tell each other about them later.
lines.zh: : 不是。我们分别去两个不同的地方各约一次会，之后再互相讲给对方听。

lines.en: : Oh. Oh, okay.
lines.zh: : 哦。哦，好吧。

lines.en: : But, wait- I don’t know any other boys. Er...uhh...{i}men.{/i}
lines.zh: : 可是，等等——我不认识别的男生啊。呃……嗯……{i}男人{/i}。

lines.en: : Good. Because I was just kidding when I said that and I do think that we should go on a date {i}together.{/i}
lines.zh: : 很好。因为我刚才是开玩笑的，我确实觉得我们应该{i}一起{/i}去约会。

lines.en: : UTHRIURHGUIHEIFUWEUIY#)(*$*$!!!!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : UTHRIURHGUIHEIFUWEUIY#)(*$*$!!!!!!!!!!!

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m excited too.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我也很兴奋。

lines.en: if karinlied == True:
: But I...you know...words!
lines.zh: : 可是我……你知道的……话都说不出来了！

lines.en: else:
: But...wait. I thought you were interested in Kirin?...
lines.zh: : 可是……等等。我还以为你对 Kirin 感兴趣呢？……

lines.en: : You didn’t mean to call her again, did you?
lines.zh: : 你不是又想打给她结果打错了吧？

lines.en: : Karin, I’ve never accidentally called you while trying to talk to her. And who says I can’t be “interested” in more than one person?
lines.zh: : Karin，我从来没有想找她聊天却误打给过你。再说了，谁规定我不能同时对不止一个人「感兴趣」？

lines.en: : Are you...
lines.zh: : 你是说……

lines.en: : Wait! Does that mean what I think it means?! Because that sounded a lot like a thing I didn’t think you meant but now I think you might actually mean!
lines.zh: : 等等！那是不是我想的那个意思？！因为那听起来很像一句我原本以为你不是那个意思、可现在又觉得你可能是真的那个意思的话！

lines.en: : Well, there’s only one way to find out and it involves meeting up with me as soon as possible.
lines.zh: : 嗯，要知道答案只有一个办法，那就是尽快来见我。

lines.en: : But I wouldn’t even know what to wear and-
lines.zh: : 可我连该穿什么都不知道，而且——

lines.en: : Cool. I’ll send you an address. Meet me there in about an hour.
lines.zh: : 很好。我把地址发给你。大概一小时后在那儿见。

lines.en: : Wait! Sensei! I-
lines.zh: : 等等！Sensei！我——

lines.en: I hang up the phone after successfully inviting Karin out on a date.
lines.zh: 成功把 Karin 约出来之后，我挂断了电话。

lines.en: And while I’m sure it will be less of a traditional “date” and more of an excuse for me to ogle at her surprisingly developed (And mildly intimidating) body for a few hours, I figure she’ll still have a good time.
lines.zh: 虽然我敢肯定这与其说是一次传统的「约会」，不如说是我找的借口，好盯着她那发育得出乎意料（而且有点吓人）的身体看上几个小时，但我想她还是会玩得很开心的。

lines.en: With each passing day, my certainty of her interest in {i}me{/i} increases.
lines.zh: 每过一天，我就越发确信她对{i}我{/i}有兴趣。

lines.en: So as she begins to open herself up like a clam in search of salt, I disintegrate into trillions of molecules and spread myself out on the large wooden table in her family’s dining room.
lines.zh: 于是当她像一只寻找盐分的蛤蜊那样开始张开自己时，我分解成万亿个分子，铺散在她家餐厅那张巨大的木桌上。

lines.en: Before long, I will feel her tongue.
lines.zh: 用不了多久，我就会感受到她的舌头。

lines.en: Before long, she will taste the salt.
lines.zh: 用不了多久，她就会尝到那盐味。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate1
: A...date...
: I’m going on...an actual date...
lines.zh: : 我要去……一场真正的约会了……

lines.en: : Congrats. Don’t forget to pack condoms.
lines.zh: : 恭喜。别忘了带上避孕套。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate2
: AH!
: Jesus. Overreact much? They’re basically just weird shaped balloons once you take away the dick.
lines.zh: : 天哪。反应这么大？把那根鸡巴去掉，它们基本就是形状奇怪的气球而已。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate3
: Why do you know so much about...c...condoms?
lines.zh: : 你怎么对……避、避孕套懂得这么多？

lines.en: : Uhh...because I’m not five?
lines.zh: : 呃……因为我不是五岁小孩？

lines.en: : You gonna tell me who that was? Or am I just going to have to stalk your Instagram to see which girl’s been hitting on you this time?
lines.zh: : 你不打算告诉我是谁吗？还是说我只能去翻你的 Instagram，看看这次又是哪个女生在撩你？

lines.en: scene karinurbandate4
: It wasn’t a girl, Kirin. I wouldn’t have agreed to a “date” if it was.
lines.zh: : 不是女生，Kirin。要是女生的话，我不会答应什么「约会」的。

lines.en: : Stop saying “date” like it’s some sort of foreign concept. It’s completely normal for a guy and girl to go out on a date and not even-
lines.zh: : 别把「约会」说得跟什么外来概念似的。一男一女出去约个会再正常不过了，就算不——

lines.en: if karinlied == False:
scene karinurbandate5
: Wait! Are you going on a date with fucking {i}Sensei?{/i}
lines.zh: : 等等！你是要跟那个该死的 {i}Sensei{/i} 去约会？

lines.en: : Would it be a problem if I was?...
lines.zh: : 如果是的话，会有问题吗？……

lines.en: : Yes! He’s {i}my{/i} fucking teacher! Find your own adult to suck off if you’re that curious about men all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 当然有问题！他是{i}我{/i}他妈的老师！你要是突然对男人这么好奇，就自己去找个成年人来舔。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate6
: J...Just because he’s interested in you doesn’t mean that I can’t talk to him too!
lines.zh: : 就、就算他对你感兴趣，也不代表我就不能跟他说话吧！

lines.en: : There will be no s...sucking! We’re just going to spend time together and talk! Like friends, but...he’s a lot older and I’m...not fun!
lines.zh: : 不会有什么舔……舔的！我们只是一起待着聊聊天！像朋友那样，只不过……他年纪大很多，而我……很无趣！

lines.en: : Well...good! Because he’s mine and I won’t let you take {i}him{/i} from me too!
lines.zh: : 嗯……很好！因为他是我的，我不会让你也把{i}他{/i}从我身边抢走！

lines.en: : Also, what is this about him being interested in me?! Please explain it to me in vivid detail!
lines.zh: : 还有，他说对我感兴趣是怎么回事？！给我绘声绘色地详细解释一下！

lines.en: scene karinurbandate7
: Ask him yourself. I have to go get ready for my {i}date.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你自己问他去吧。我得去为我的{i}约会{/i}做准备了。

lines.en: : Maybe I will. And good luck {i}getting ready-{/i} whatever the fuck that means. I can’t even {i}remember{/i} the last time you put on makeup.
lines.zh: : 我也许真会去。还有祝你{i}准备{/i}顺利——管他那是什么意思。我都{i}想不起来{/i}你上次化妆是什么时候了。

lines.en: : Maybe I’m just...more confident in my face than...you are in yours? Jerk.
lines.zh: : 也许只是我……比你对自己的脸更有自信罢了？混蛋。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate8
: Our faces aren’t even that different!
lines.zh: : 我们的脸根本就没差那么多好吗！

lines.en: : Let me go instead! I’m not doing anything today! And the fact that my older sister is going to be out with {i}my{/i} man just doesn’t fucking sit well with me!
lines.zh: : 让我替你去吧！我今天又没事！而且一想到我姐姐要跟{i}我的{/i}男人出去，我这心里就他妈的受不了！

lines.en: : If he’s {i}your{/i} man, I guess you won’t have anything to worry about.
lines.zh: : 如果他是{i}你的{/i}男人，那你大概就没什么好担心的了。

lines.en: : Also, Mom says it’s your turn to vacuum the house. So you {i}will{/i} have something to do today.
lines.zh: : 还有，妈妈说今天轮到你给家里吸尘。所以你今天有事{i}可{/i}做了。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate9
: Are you fucking kidding me?!
lines.zh: : 你他妈的在跟我开玩笑吧？！

lines.en: : Since when do you just walk away when I’m arguing with you?! I’m the one who’s supposed to walk away!
lines.zh: : 你什么时候开始敢在我跟你吵的时候直接走人了？！该走的人是我才对！

lines.en: : Can’t hear you! Trying to...find a good makeup tutorial!
lines.zh: : 听不见！我正在……找一个好的化妆教程！

lines.en: scene karinurbandate10
: That better not be my Youtube you’re logged into, you bitch! You’ll fuck my algorithm!
lines.zh: : 你最好别登的是我的 Youtube，你这个贱人！你会把我的推荐算法搞乱的！

lines.en: else:
scene karinurbandate11
: Wait. Are you going on a date with fucking {i}Sensei?{/i} My teacher?
lines.zh: : 等等。你是要跟那个该死的 {i}Sensei{/i} 去约会？我的老师？

lines.en: : I’m sorry Kirin, but I’m not the type to kiss and tell.
lines.zh: : 不好意思啊 Kirin，我可不是那种会亲完嘴还到处说的人。

lines.en: : You’re not the type to kiss at all.
lines.zh: : 你压根就不是会亲嘴的那种人。

lines.en: : Yeah. Even saying that made me want to curl up into a ball and throw myself out of the window.
lines.zh: : 是啊。光是说出这句话，我就想缩成一团从窗户跳出去。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate12
: Well, then why the fuck are you going out on a date with a guy?! Let alone {i}that{/i} guy?!
lines.zh: : 那你他妈的到底为什么要跟一个男的出去约会？！更别说是{i}那个{/i}男的？！

lines.en: : How do you expect things to go when he wants more than you’re willing to give?!
lines.zh: : 等他想要的东西超出你愿意给的范围时，你打算怎么办？！

lines.en: : I have no idea what {i}things{/i} you think Sensei expects from me, but he’s been nothing but kind to me so far and has never once tried to force me out of my comfort zone.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你觉得 Sensei 想从我这里得到{i}什么{/i}，但他到目前为止对我一直都很温柔，也从来没有逼我去做任何让我不舒服的事。

lines.en: : I think that’s...probably why I was able to say yes just now. With anyone else, I’m sure I would have just...you know, {i}actually{/i} thrown myself out of the window.
lines.zh: : 我想……大概就是因为这样，我刚才才答应的吧。换作别人，我肯定早就……你知道的，{i}真的{/i}从窗户跳下去了。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate13
: Can...Can I go instead?
lines.zh: : 我……我能替你去吗？

lines.en: : Instead?...
: Yeah. Like, you can...call out sick or something.
lines.zh: : 嗯。就是说，你可以……装病推掉之类的。

lines.en: : I am no expert, but I don’t think dates work that way. And besides, I...
lines.zh: : 我不是什么专家，但我觉得约会不是这么操作的。而且，我……

lines.en: : I {i}want{/i} to go...
: Since when do you have literally {i}any{/i} interest in boys, though?
lines.zh: : 可你从什么时候开始对男孩子有{i}一丁点{/i}兴趣了？

lines.en: scene karinurbandate14
: It’s less an interest in boys and...more an interest in {i}him...{/i}I think.
lines.zh: : 与其说是对男孩子感兴趣……倒不如说是对{i}他{/i}感兴趣……我想。

lines.en: : I don’t know. My feelings are kind of all over the place right now...and it sounds hard to believe, but my heart is currently beating a billion times faster than it ever did during soccer.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。现在我的心情乱成一团……说出来你可能不信，可我现在心跳的速度，比踢足球时最激烈的时候还要快上十亿倍。

lines.en: : Besides, I...I’m sure he was only using the word “date” to mess with me. It’s not like Sensei would ever actually {i}want{/i} to date me, you know? Our parents wouldn’t ever allow it either.
lines.zh: : 再说，我……我敢肯定他只是拿「约会」这个词逗我玩而已。Sensei 不可能真的{i}想{/i}跟我交往的，你知道吧？我们的父母也绝对不会允许的。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate15
: I’m sure they’d make an exception for {i}you{/i} as long as you asked.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，只要你开口，他们一定会为{i}你{/i}破例的。

lines.en: : Kirin...can you maybe try to be happy that {i}I{/i} am really happy right now? Because that would mean a lot to me.
lines.zh: : Kirin……你能不能试着为{i}我{/i}真的这么开心而高兴一下？因为那对我来说意义重大。

lines.en: : Okay.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: : Well, I’m going to go get ready. But Mom told me to tell you it’s your turn to vacuum the house.
lines.zh: : 那我去准备了。不过妈妈让我转告你，今天轮到你给家里吸尘。

lines.en: : Yeah, of course she did.
lines.zh: : 嗯，她当然会这么说。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate10
: Can you help me with my makeup? I have no idea what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 你能帮我化个妆吗？我完全不知道自己在干什么。

lines.en: : Just watch a fucking Youtube video or something.
lines.zh: : 自己去看个该死的 Youtube 视频不就行了。

lines.en: scene black
scene karinurbandate16
: Umm...h...hello...
lines.zh: : 嗯……你、你好……

lines.en: : Woah.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate17
: It doesn’t suit me, does it?
lines.zh: : 这身不适合我，对吧？

lines.en: : It suits you fine. Maybe a little {i}too{/i} fine- which is an added benefit for me since now the chances of you being mistaken for a high school student have been all but eliminated.
lines.zh: : 很适合你啊。也许有点{i}太{/i}适合了——这对我来说反倒是额外的好处，因为现在你被误认成高中生的概率基本已经归零了。

lines.en: : But...But I {i}am{/i} a high school student.
lines.zh: : 可……可我本来就{i}是{/i}高中生啊。

lines.en: : Not while we’re in public, you’re not.
lines.zh: : 在公共场合的时候，你就不是了。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate18
: I think I can...probably remember that...
lines.zh: : 我想我……大概能记住的……

lines.en: : I didn’t keep you waiting too long, did I? I didn’t really expect to have to come all the way over to the urban district, so...I might’ve left a little later than I probably should have.
lines.zh: : 我没让你等太久吧？我真没想到要一路跑到市中心来，所以……出门的时间可能比应该的晚了一点。

lines.en: : It’s no big deal. I figured there was a decent chance that you were going to chicken out and send Kirin in your place or something anyway.
lines.zh: : 没什么大不了的。我本来还觉得你挺有可能临阵退缩，让 Kirin 替你来呢。

lines.en: if karinlied == False:
scene karinurbandate19
: Would you...have preferred that?
lines.zh: : 那样的话……你会更开心吗？

lines.en: : Why would I personally invite you if it was your sister I was after?
lines.zh: : 如果我想追的是你妹妹，我干嘛要亲自来约你？

lines.en: : I don’t know...this is all just so crazy and...sudden...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……这一切都太疯狂，而且……太突然了……

lines.en: : Kind of like a...a...dream...
lines.zh: : 有点像……一场……一场梦……

lines.en: scene karinurbandate20
: Oh God! This {i}is{/i} a dream, isn’t it?! This whole day has been a dream and I am going to wake up in five minutes and still have no idea how to tie the ribbon thing on my dress!
lines.zh: : 天哪！这{i}是{/i}梦，对不对？！今天一整天都是梦，五分钟后我就会醒来，而且还是不知道我裙子上的那根带子该怎么系！

lines.en: : Or...that’s not going to happen and we’re going to spend the rest of the afternoon hanging out together.
lines.zh: : 或者……那不会发生，我们会一起度过今天剩下的整个下午。

lines.en: : That sounds exactly like what dream-Sensei would say!
lines.zh: : 这话说得简直跟梦里的 Sensei 一模一样！

lines.en: : You sound pretty familiar with this “dream-Sensei” guy.
lines.zh: : 你跟这个「梦里的 Sensei」听起来挺熟的嘛。

lines.en: : You should know because you are him!
lines.zh: : 你应该最清楚了，因为你就是他啊！

lines.en: : Karin, it’s really me. Like, the {i}real life{/i} me.
lines.zh: : Karin，真的是我。就是{i}现实生活{/i}中的我。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I can believe you.
lines.zh: : 我不知道能不能相信你。

lines.en: scene black
: Okay. I guess I’ll just leave, then.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那我大概就只能走了。

lines.en: : Wait! I believe you now! Don’t leave me here alone! What if someone hits on me?! I’m not prepared for that!
lines.zh: : 等等！我现在相信你了！别把我一个人丢在这儿！万一有人来搭讪怎么办？！我可没准备好！

lines.en: else:
scene karinurbandate21
: She actually...tried to come in my place and...I thought about letting her, but...
lines.zh: : 她其实……真的想替我来，而且……我有想过答应她，可是……

lines.en: : I was...a little too excited...
lines.zh: : 我……实在太兴奋了……

lines.en: : I’ve never really...gone out with anyone like this before...
lines.zh: : 我还从来没有……像这样跟谁出来过……

lines.en: : Well, I’m glad you didn’t let her come because this is the exact side of you I’ve been hoping to see for a long while now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我很高兴你没让她来，因为你现在的这个样子，正是我很久以来一直想看到的一面。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate22
: Stop...
lines.zh: : 别说了……

lines.en: : I’m serious. I’ve always thought you-
lines.zh: : 我是认真的。我一直觉得你——

lines.en: : No, like...really stop...I think I’m about to have a heart attack...
lines.zh: : 不是，我是说……真的别说了……我觉得我快要心脏骤停了……

lines.en: : With all the cardio you do? Doubt it. Just accept my compliments and tell me I look handsome as well or something so we can get this show on the road.
lines.zh: : 就凭你做的那些心肺训练？我表示怀疑。乖乖收下我的赞美，再说点什么夸我帅的话，好让我们赶紧出发。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate23
: You look...
lines.zh: : 你看起来……

lines.en: : You...
: Tall.
lines.zh: : 很高。

lines.en: scene black
: Close enough. Good job, Karin.
lines.zh: : 差不多够了。干得好，Karin。

lines.en: : Wait! Sensei, where are you going?! I don’t even know what the plan is yet!
lines.zh: : 等等！Sensei，你要去哪儿？！我都还不知道计划是什么！

lines.en: I walk off in the direction opposite where Karin came from, but not because I have a specific location in mind.
lines.zh: 我朝着 Karin 来的反方向走去，但这并不是因为我心里已经想好了要去哪儿。

lines.en: Is inviting someone out on a date despite not having a concrete plan of what to do if they accept a little unorthodox? I guess.
lines.zh: 明明没想好对方答应之后要做什么，就约人出来，这算不算有点不按常理出牌？大概算吧。

lines.en: But, honestly? With the way Karin looks right now, I kind of {i}want{/i} to be seen in public with her rather than spend the afternoon inside of a dimly lit movie theater or something.
lines.zh: 不过说真的？以 Karin 现在的样子，我更{i}想{/i}被别人看到和她一起走在街上，而不是整个下午都待在光线昏暗的电影院里什么的。

lines.en: Who knows? Maybe we’ll find a park or something and I can nod my head at all of the other women who walk by and stare at us for reasons that I’m sure are more complicated than me actually having a penis.
lines.zh: 谁知道呢？也许我们会找到个公园之类的地方，然后我可以朝所有路过的女人点头致意——她们盯着我们看的理由，我敢肯定比我真的有根鸡巴这件事要复杂得多。

lines.en: Those are pretty rare around here nowadays.
lines.zh: 这年头，这一带已经很少见到了。

lines.en: But I digress.
lines.zh: 不过我扯远了。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate25
Karin quickly catches up to me and takes her place by my side, leaving a little less space between us than I expected from her.
lines.zh: Karin 很快追上来，走到了我身边，和我之间留出的距离比我预想的要小一些。

lines.en: It is in this moment that I decide to let her in on the fact that I do not have a plan for this outing so that she doesn’t wind up getting depressed when we start walking around in circles.
lines.zh: 就在这一刻，我决定告诉她这趟出门我没有任何计划，免得等我们开始原地打转时她会心情低落。

lines.en: : Karin, I have bad news for you.
lines.zh: : Karin，我有个坏消息要告诉你。

lines.en: : I knew it. You {i}did{/i} want Kirin to come instead of me, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 我就知道。你{i}果然是{/i}想让 Kirin 替我来，对吧？

lines.en: : Stop saying that. I was just going to tell you that this is about to be the most boring date of your life because, despite being notoriously bad at making plans, I continue to do just that for reasons I don’t understand.
lines.zh: : 别再这么说了。我只是想告诉你，这大概会是你人生中最无聊的一次约会，因为尽管我在做计划这方面出了名的糟糕，我还是出于某种我自己也说不清的理由继续这么做。

lines.en: : Oh, that’s okay. It’s also the most exciting date of my life, so you can be happy knowing that the bar is impossibly low.
lines.zh: : 哦，没关系啊。它同时也是我人生中最让人兴奋的一次约会，所以你可以放心了，反正标准低得离谱。

lines.en: : I have never been happier to hear those words.
lines.zh: : 我从没因为听到一句话而这么开心过。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate24
: And I don’t think I’ve...ever been happier to be invited out before...
lines.zh: : 而且我大概……也从来没有因为被约出来而这么开心过……

lines.en: : Please, proceed. I want to hear more about how awesome you think I am.
lines.zh: : 请继续。我还想多听听你觉得我有多厉害。

lines.en: : Well, it’s just...you know...
lines.zh: : 嗯，就是……你知道的……

lines.en: : Ever since the soccer team disbanded and you stopped being our coach, I’ve been seeing you less and less while my sister still gets to see you all the time...
lines.zh: : 自从足球社解散、你不再是我们的教练之后，我见到你的次数越来越少了，可我妹妹还是能经常见到你……

lines.en: : So whenever she talks about you, I...start to kind of miss you, I guess...
lines.zh: : 所以每次她提起你的时候，我……就会开始有点想你了吧……

lines.en: : I miss you randomly showing up to practice and...watching over all of us to make sure we don’t get hurt.
lines.zh: : 我会想念你随随便便出现在训练场、然后……守着我们所有人、确保我们不会受伤的样子。

lines.en: : Yup. That is exactly why I was watching all of you. Good catch.
lines.zh: : 对。我看你们所有人就是这个原因。你抓得挺准。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate25
: That was probably weird, right? Hearing that I...you know...missed you?
lines.zh: : 那大概很怪吧？听到我说……那个……想你？

lines.en: : Not really since you’re already falling in love with me.
lines.zh: : 也不算，毕竟你已经爱上我了嘛。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate26
: Okay, maybe not {i}love-{/i} but you definitely feel something, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 好吧，也许还算不上{i}爱——{/i}但你肯定是有什么感觉的，对吧？

lines.en: : I can’t really imagine you “missing” me without that being the case.
lines.zh: : 我实在想不到，你会「想我」却不带点那种感觉。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate27
: Well, it’s...true that I did miss you...but I don’t know if there are any...uhh...what do you call them?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我确实有想你……但我不知道这里面有没有什么……呃……那个叫什么来着？

lines.en: : Feelings?...
: Yeah! I don’t know if there are any {i}feelings{/i} involved in that!
lines.zh: : 对！我不知道这算不算有什么{i}感情{/i}在里面！

lines.en: : I just got so used to you being around that...once you stopped being around as much, I started to get sad and want to see you more.
lines.zh: : 我只是太习惯你在身边了……所以一旦你不再那么常在，我就开始难过，也开始更想见你。

lines.en: : Yeah. So, to hearken back to what I was just saying, you like me.
lines.zh: : 嗯。所以回到我刚才说的那句话——你喜欢我。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate28
: S-S-S-S-S-S-S-STOP SAYING THAT! HOW ARE YOU NOT EMBARRASSED?!
lines.zh: : 别、别、别、别、别、别、别、别再说了！你到底怎么做到一点都不害臊的？！

lines.en: : Because it’s not a big deal. I literally invited you out already knowing this about you.
lines.zh: : 因为这不是什么大不了的事。我约你出来的时候，早就知道你是这样的了。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate29
: How do you know things about me before even I do?!
lines.zh: : 你怎么能连我自己都还不知道的事都先知道？！

lines.en: : Because I understand this subject a lot better than you do. And that’s totally fine. Move at your own pace or whatever and I’ll just...try to match it.
lines.zh: : 因为我对这方面懂得比你多得多。这完全没问题。你按自己的节奏来就好，我会……尽量跟上你。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate30
: If...that really {i}is{/i} what it is, though...isn’t that {i}bad?{/i}
lines.zh: : 可……如果真的{i}就是{/i}那样的话……那不是很{i}糟糕{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Would it even be okay for me to feel things like that for you?...
lines.zh: : 我对你有那种感觉，真的可以吗？……

lines.en: : I don’t think there are any feelings that are just naturally {i}bad{/i} unless you’re the type of person to act on them. But even then, {i}this{/i} feeling wouldn’t ever be on the bad side.
lines.zh: : 我觉得没有什么感情天生就是{i}坏{/i}的，除非你是那种会付诸行动的人。但就算那样，{i}这种{/i}感觉也永远不会属于坏的那一边。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, I just...I’m having a really hard time wrapping my head around why you’d say that.
lines.zh: : 对不起，我只是……实在想不明白你为什么会这么说。

lines.en: : What don’t you understand?
lines.zh: : 你哪里不明白？

lines.en: : Just...you know...
lines.zh: : 就是……那个……

lines.en: : Don’t you see me as a kid in your eyes?
lines.zh: : 在你眼里，你就没把我当成小孩子吗？

lines.en: if karinlied == True:
: Didn't we already talk about this when you made sushi a while ago? I don't see you that way at all.
lines.zh: : 你前阵子做寿司的时候，我们不是已经聊过这个了吗？我完全没有那样看你。

lines.en: : Yeah, but...
lines.zh: : 嗯，可是……

lines.en: : You could be lying...
lines.zh: : 你也可能是在骗我……

lines.en: : I literally asked you out on a date today.
lines.zh: : 我今天可是实打实地约你出来约会了。

lines.en: : Yeah, but...you can go on dates like this without wanting anything out of them, can’t you?
lines.zh: : 嗯，可是……像这样的约会，也可以什么都不图就去吧？

lines.en: if karinlied == False:
: I’ve also confirmed my interest in your sister who is both younger {i}and{/i} smaller than you.
lines.zh: : 我还明确表示过对你妹妹感兴趣，而她比你更小、年纪{i}也{/i}更轻。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate31
: Don’t bring her up anymore. This is {i}my{/i} date.
lines.zh: : 别再提她了。今天是{i}我的{/i}约会。

lines.en: : Sorry. Please continue.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。请继续。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate30
: I don’t know...I have this problem where I overthink a lot and every time I remember who you are and who {i}I{/i} am, I start to feel like this is all going to fall apart and that’s...really scary.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道……我这人有个毛病，就是想太多，每次一想起你是谁、{i}我{/i}是谁，我就开始觉得这一切迟早会崩塌，而那……真的很可怕。

lines.en: : At least if things fell apart now, it’s not like the damage would be really bad. And I still have no idea what I’m doing when it comes to...uhh...{i}co-educational{/i} relationships...
lines.zh: : 至少要是现在就崩了，损失也不算太惨重。而且说到……呃……{i}男女{/i}关系之类的……我还是完全不知道自己在干什么。

lines.en: : Just “relationships” is fine.
lines.zh: : 说「交往」就可以了。

lines.en: : Yeah. That. Me not knowing what I’m doing makes me feel like I’m just going to, like...knock everything over and cause a huge mess.
lines.zh: : 嗯。就是那个。我因为不知道自己在干什么，总觉得我会……把什么都撞翻，然后弄得一团糟。

lines.en: : And I just don’t really want to make a mess like that in front of you or...do anything that will prevent you from wanting to see me anymore.
lines.zh: : 而我真的不想在你面前弄出那种烂摊子，或者……做出任何会让你再也不想见我的事。

lines.en: : Which is why I probably {i}do{/i} feel the way you said I feel but it’s not like I can {i}tell{/i} you I feel that way because then I'll know that I {i}do{/i} feel that way and that feels scary.
lines.zh: : 所以我说不定{i}真的{/i}像你说的那样，可我又不能{i}告诉{/i}你我是那样想的，因为一旦说了，我就确定自己{i}真的{/i}是那样想的了，而那太吓人了。

lines.en: : Well, it’s clear that your brain is already going in circles right now, so these words might not sound like anything important to you, but-
lines.zh: : 嗯，很明显你现在脑子里已经在原地打转了，所以这些话对你来说可能听起来不算什么，不过——

lines.en: : You have nothing to be afraid of.
lines.zh: : 你没什么好怕的。

lines.en: scene karinurbandate32
: And...you really don’t see me as a kid?
lines.zh: : 还有……你真的没把我当成小孩子吗？

lines.en: : To be honest, I don’t think many people do. You both look and {i}act{/i} much older than you are, which is really all that matters to me.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我觉得大多数人也不会。你的外表和{i}举止{/i}都比实际年龄要成熟得多，而对我来说，这才是真正重要的。

lines.en: (It doesn’t.)
lines.zh: （并不是。）

lines.en: : Thanks, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Sensei……

lines.en: : I do have one question, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我还有一个问题。

lines.en: : Sure. You can ask me anything.
lines.zh: : 当然。你什么都可以问。

lines.en: : Okay...so...
: Don’t get mad, but...
lines.zh: : 你别生气啊，不过……

lines.en: : Can we maybe...{i}not{/i} walk in circles for the rest of our date?
lines.zh: : 我们能不能……{i}别{/i}在剩下的约会里继续原地打转了？

lines.en: : I’m getting really hungry...
lines.zh: : 我真的好饿……

lines.en: scene black

Karin and I spend the rest of our afternoon inside of various air-conditioned buildings so she can refill her energy stores and keep herself from sweating- a thing she is apparently very concerned about today.
lines.zh: 我和 Karin 剩下的下午都在各种有空调的建筑里度过，好让她补充体力、也免得自己出汗——她今天显然很在意这件事。

lines.en: And while I did initially claim that I wanted to remain in public and nod at other women or whatever, the heat forces me to once again act in opposition to myself as I, too, change stances.
lines.zh: 虽然我一开始说过想待在外面、朝路过的女人点头什么的，但酷热迫使我再一次和自己作对，也改变了立场。

lines.en: Fortunately, every building we walked into, from patisserie to pop-up shop, was packed with people.
lines.zh: 幸运的是，我们走进的每一家店——从法式甜品店到快闪店——都是人满为患。

lines.en: And I found myself, more often than not, actually thinking of Karin as my girlfriend rather than a pure soul who just keeps wandering into the wrong places at the wrong times.
lines.zh: 而且我发现自己大多数时候真的把 Karin 当成了我的女朋友，而不是一个总在错误的时间走进错误地点的纯洁灵魂。

lines.en: We enjoy our day together.
lines.zh: 我们一起度过了愉快的一天。

lines.en: I replay it in my head as I collapse onto my mattress and remove my belt.
lines.zh: 我瘫倒在床垫上、解开腰带的时候，又在脑海里把这一天重放了一遍。

lines.en: $ karindate30 = True
$ karin_love += 5
{i}Karin’s affection has increased to [karin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Karin 的好感度提升到了 [karin_love]！{/i}
